The '''Morobe sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. [[Rachuk sector/Legends|Rachuk sector]] was coreward of it. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector include [[Talasea]].
